Wake Forest ranks 133rd in the FBS averaging 115 penalty yards per game, and Purdue ranks 124th with an 85-yard average. Wake Forest is 59th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 100% of trips. Purdue's red zone offense ranks 1st, scoring on 100% of red zone opportunities. Wake Forest ranks 83rd in the FBS with an average time of possession of 29:24, compared to Purdue's 14th-ranked average of 37:22. Team leaders Wake Forest Passing: Gio Lopez, 350 yards, 3 TDs, 0 INTs, 65.6 completion percentage Rushing: Ty Clark, 105 yards on 7 carries, 0 TDs Receiving: Carlos Hernandez, 165 yards on 5 catches, 1 TD Purdue Passing: Ryan Browne, 317 yards, 3 TDs, 0 INTs, 79.3 completion percentage Rushing: Fame Ijeboi, 87 yards on 11 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Asaad Waseem, 107 yards on 6 catches, 1 TD Last game Wake Forest beat Akron 38-16 on Sept. 3. Hernandez had five receptions for 165 yards and one touchdown. Purdue won 44-19 over Indiana State on Sept. 4. Browne led Purdue with 317 yards on 23-of-29 passing (79.3%) for three touchdowns and no interceptions. Ijeboi had 87 rushing yards on 11 carries and one touchdown, adding two receptions for 30 yards. Waseem recorded 107 yards on six catches with one touchdown. Next game Wake Forest hosts No. 7 Miami (FL) on Sept. 18. Purdue plays at UCLA on Sept. 19.
